title: Categorical vs Categorical Association Analysis
description: Contingency table analysis to determine independence and strength of association between two categorical variables.
conditions: Investigation of demographic or behavioral interactions
recommended_methods: Two-way cross-tabulation with row and column percentage distributions
Cramer's V statistic for association strength measurement
selection_rules: If any cell in contingency table has expected frequency < 5, apply Fisher's Exact Test or combine sparse categories
Interpret Cramer's V: < 0.10 negligible, 0.10-0.30 moderate, > 0.30 strong association
Report normalized standardized residuals to pinpoint specific cells driving chi-square significance
limitations: Chi-square p-value becomes statistically significant on very large N even for trivial associations
